title: Harbour porpoise detections per hour on 172 C-POD and F-POD deployments at 24 stations, Belgian part of the North Sea, 2014-2024
creator: Debusschere, Elisabeth; Calonge, Arienne; Conings, Bram (Flanders Marine Institute, VLIZ)
citation: Debusschere E, Calonge A, Conings B (2026). LifeWatch observatory data: Permanent Cetacean passive acoustic sensor network in the Belgian Part of the North Sea. Version 1.10. Flanders Marine Institute (VLIZ). Samplingevent dataset. https://doi.org/10.14284/639
abstract: Passive acoustic monitoring of harbour porpoise (Phocoena phocoena) in the LifeWatch cetacean network of VLIZ: C-POD and F-POD click loggers moored next to shipwrecks and other structures at 24 stations in the Belgian part of the North Sea, 2014-2024. Porpoise click trains are classified by the KERNO classifier and summarised per hour as detection-positive minutes out of minutes recorded. One row per deployment-hour with recording time: y = 1 if any minute in the hour had a porpoise detection, y_raw = detection-positive minutes, obs_recorded_min = minutes recorded, obs_total_clicks = all clicks logged. The unit is the deployment (172), and cluster_id is the station, so simultaneous deployments at a station (paired C-POD and F-POD, or overlap during a swap) are separate units.
samplingProtocol: Continuous recording by moored C-POD or F-POD click loggers; clicks classified as narrow-band high-frequency porpoise click trains by the KERNO classifier (cpod.exe), summarised per hour as detection-positive minutes and minutes recorded.
closureNote: period = calendar month, occasion = hour of the month (UTC); porpoise presence at a station changes within hours, so occupancy within a month is use, not a closed state. date and obs_hour_utc allow any regrouping (day, week, season).
geographicCoverage: Belgian part of the North Sea (51.2-51.8 N, 2.4-3.1 E)

coordinatesCoarsened.method: Phocoena phocoena is Least Concern (IUCN); offshore mooring positions kept as published (4 decimals).

notes: Detections are the KERNO classifier's output as published (automated, not validated by hand). Recording time is under 60 minutes in some hours (deployment start and end, battery or memory end); use obs_recorded_min as effort. One F-POD deployment at ReefballsBelwind (D57130) is published 0.1 deg east of the station's other deployments. Licence: CC BY 4.0, confirmed by VLIZ (E. Debusschere, 2026-11-10) after earlier versions carried a not-for-profit accessRights note.

notShipped.Number of filtered clicks: clicks in classified porpoise trains per hour: a second measure of the same detection, not a covariate
notShipped.device-type events: 01_CPOD / 02_FPOD parent events; their instrument is unit_device
